meta.001: MarketVision builds technology for African commerce and logistics. Explore AfricMade, CargoChatter and Loadgistic.
copy.007: We build technology for commerce and logistics businesses to find customers, connect with partners and coordinate transport.
access.004: Illustration of an AfricMade supplier showroom
copy.021: Farm produce, handmade goods and manufactured products in a supplier showroom, with a location map and an enquiry form.
copy.028: AfricMade gives farms, makers and manufacturers a digital showroom for products, business details and location. Buyers can discover suppliers and send enquiries for a single item or a larger order, then agree availability and terms directly.
access.006: Illustration of the Loadgistic transport map
copy.035: A map of vehicles and routes beside a truck showing available cargo space, a private sharing option and shipment progress.
copy.040: Loadgistic helps transporters manage vehicles and share capacity and routes publicly or with selected customers. Shippers and brokers can review available space and build their transporter network. Private updates keep the people involved in agreed shipments informed.

portfolio.cargochatterBody: CargoChatter brings provider profiles and shipment conversations into websites and apps. Platforms choose which providers appear; buyers and sellers discuss shipments with them. Provider teams manage profiles, assign enquiries from participating sites and discuss shipment details and quotes in one inbox.
portfolio.cargochatterAlt: Illustration of a logistics provider profile beside a chat window on a business website
company.metaDescription: About MarketVision Technology, the East African company behind AfricMade, CargoChatter and Loadgistic.
company.heading:
Built around
African business.
company.intro: MarketVision Technology is an East African technology company based in Jigjiga, Ethiopia. We own, develop and operate AfricMade, CargoChatter and Loadgistic.
company.purposeHeading:
The connections
that make trade work.
company.purpose: We build for a market where businesses can reach customers beyond their existing networks and find the partners they need to trade. Our platforms make products and suppliers discoverable, bring shipment enquiries to logistics providers, and give transporters tools to manage vehicles, share capacity and coordinate work.
